mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 61 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park with partly cloudy skies and a waxing gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to a low of 51 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city is preparing for the fall leaf pickup season starting October 5, so keep your piles on the curb and clear of obstacles. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including site plans for the Sub-Zero facility in Liberty Business Park.

Today is a busy one in Verona! We have live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and pitchers at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow, and later this week we have live music at Bailey's Run, the Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park, and more live music at Lake Lou-ee.

Looking at the recent police activity, on September 5, an officer located multiple vehicles with a slice of cheese on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank, which thankfully caused no damage.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a facility remodel, so we are waiting for that to wrap up.
